item.title: Visualizing energy transfer across a hexagonal Cs 4 PbBr 6 microdisk using single-particle spectroscopy
item.description:
Authors: Soumik De, Mrinal Kanti Panda, Subhadip Ghosh

Spatial mapping of energy transfer in hexagonal Cs 4 PbBr 6 perovskite microdisks reveals enhanced core efficiency due to increased dye occupancy in structural cavities.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00287k

item.title: Electrospinning-based architectural engineering of multi-layered fibrous membranes with spatially defined wettability for solar desalination
item.description:
Authors: Dianming Li, Chuang Cheng, Yanxia Luo, Xi Yao, Libang Feng

A sequentially electrospun PAN–PS–PAN fibrous membrane with spatially defined wettability coordinates water transport and heat localization for efficient solar-driven interfacial evaporation.

DOI: 10.1039/d6nh00279j
